note: Sealed held-out evaluation set. NEVER train, grind, coevolve, or rollout on these (family, seed, difficulty). The reserved seed band 7000000+ is for eval only. A model's discovery is scored on first contact with these worlds; because they are generated from random seeds, their truths exist in no pretraining corpus, so transfer here measures learned discovering rather than recall. (collatz seed set to 7000012: a non-degenerate map with both cyclic and diverging starts; 7000006 was pure doubling — no discoverable structure.)
